ships.name: Shrike
ships.brief: A low command head leads a short neck and a broad engineering body. Down-swept weapon wings give the raider a crouched, predatory silhouette.
notes: Purple armor and orange identification bands.
Stairs, elevator and independent ladder connect every main deck.
Two fighter berths and the approved hull proportions are retained.
adjustments: Dedicated shaft volumes are cut out of adjacent rooms.
Relocated doors preserve clear corridor approaches.
Furnishings are refitted around the access towers.
